MRI Safety Information
Non-clinical testing has demonstrated that the Cobalt Neuromodulation System is MR Conditional. A patient with this device can be safely scanned in an MR system meeting the following conditions:
· Static magnetic field of ≤ 3 T
· Spatial field gradient: ≤ 2,500 G/cm (25 T/m) or less
· Maximum MR system reported, whole body averaged specific absorption rate (SAR) of 0.5 W/kg (Normal Operating Mode)
· No more than 60 minutes of active scan time per session
· Followed by a wait time of 5 minutes
· Any receive-only coil may be used
· RF excitation: circularly polarized (CP) only
· Device configuration: MRI SureScan mode
· Scan regions: Only head and lower extremity landmarks are permitted
Under the scan conditions defined above, the Cobalt Neuromodulation System is expected to produce a maximum temperature rise of less than 2.4 °C after 15 minutes of continuous scanning.
In non-clinical testing, the image artifact caused by the device extends approximately 10 mm from the device when imaged with a gradient echo pulse sequence and a 3 T MR system.
